limits: Synchronous production source renderer updates in happy-dom; no layout, paint, browser frame, mount, SSR, hydration, or async timing.
Compile and bundle times, source hashing, public semantic checks, CPU counter calls, GC event delivery, and teardown verification are outside measured update intervals.
The selected supplemental source toolchain is unchanged; this is not a locked workspace or CI gate.
All measured wall samples, including samples overlapping GC or host scheduling delays, remain in the primary results.
A wide paired uncertainty interval is inconclusive; no wall-clock pass threshold or outlier filter is introduced.

configuration.pairOrder: Seeded ABBA or BAAB; both versions run twice per pair
configuration.lifecycle: Roots live across the focused update measurement; mounting and SSR remain in the separate unchanged full harness.

method: Use the unchanged production buildCase/dataFor/checkElement helpers and authored TSRX fixture; keep one live root per case/version, preallocate props, warm each version eight full update blocks, then time seeded ABBA/BAAB blocks with randomized case order. Public output/identity and native signal updates are verified outside each timed block. All timing samples are retained.
diagnosticsPolicy: Process CPU, main-thread CPU and GC overlaps are separate diagnostics and never replace primary wall timing or justify removing samples.
invocationParity: Every version uses the same measure function, same loop body, one flushSync callback per update, preallocated props arrays of equal length and identical public output/identity checks. No per-version wrapper or special-case timed path.

referenceEvidence.role: Require exact bundle bytes when rebuilding archived cd9/422c; final candidate records hashes without claiming equality.

outlierPolicy: Retain every sample and GC event. Report arithmetic absolute timings, paired ratio distribution, geometric mean ratio and Student-t95% interval on log ratios. Never drop outliers or infer parity from a wide interval.
